name: one-skill-to-rule-them-all
description: The meta-skill that builds and improves all your skills, including itself. Watches your work sessions, captures corrections and judgement calls, and turns them into skill improvements automatically. Practical application of the Augmented Expertise methodology. Open-source, domain-agnostic, CC BY 4.0.
